subject: banshee-haven
q: CLOSED — six couples, and the pattern held.
detail: Bell, Elspeth, Magnolia, Daisey, Alexis and Lyric arrive in Arc 13; Eirwen, Remielle, Claudia, Hela, Orianna and Felicity in Arc 14. Twelve is six couples if the pattern of both other houses holds — every girl in Ghost Haven and Specter Haven is devotion-locked to exactly one other. Not a single pairing is recorded, and the Archive has guessed none of them. Nor are there surnames for any of the twelve.
